scanNote:
5-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (38-bet).

Yuqorida chapda YASHIL yorliqda oq '5' va 'Planning Ahead'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Conditionals Type 1'.
22) 'Study the examples, then complete the rule.' OCh KO'K quti, yuqorisida oq katta harflar 'Use':
   Qizil qiya: 'IF you DON'T HURRY UP, you WILL MISS the bus.' / 'IF I HAVE enough money, I'LL MOVE to a bigger house.'
   'Form: ......... + present simple ......... + infinitive without to'
   • 'We use conditionals type 1 to talk about REAL or VERY PROBABLE situations in the present or future.'
23) 'Match the prompts in A to the ones in B. Then, act out dialogues in pairs, as in the example.'
   Ikki ustunli PUShTI-shaftoli quti:
     A: 1 haven't got any money, 2 car breaks down, 3 a sunny day tomorrow, 4 get hungry, 5 go to London
     B: a go on a picnic, b visit Buckingham Palace, c phone for help, d borrow some, e make a sandwich
   ⚠ 1-banddan 'd' ga KO'K STRELKA chizilgan (namuna).
   Ostida ko'k qiya: 'SA: What will you do if you haven't got any money? SB: If I haven't got any money, I'll borrow some.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking'.
24) 'Follow the arrows and make sentences.' RANGLI OVALLAR va strelkalar zanjiri:
   YaShIL 'Jack/not hear his alarm clock' → TO'Q SARIQ 'he/not wake up' → SARIQ 'he/be late for his interview' → KO'KIMTIR-YaShIL 'he/not get the job' → OCh KO'K 'he/not earn any money' → SHAFTOLI 'he/spend his savings' → OQ 'he/be in big trouble!'
   Ostida ko'k qiya: 'S1: If Jack doesn't hear his alarm clock, he won't wake up. S2: If he doesn't wake up, ...'
25) 'Complete the sentences.' Sakkizta gap boshi, nuqtali joylar (7 va 8 O'NG USTUNNING YUQORISIDA davom etadi):
   1 If Jackie studies hard, 2 If you don't hurry, 3 If I win £10,000, 4 If they go to Paris, 5 If Bill eats all the chocolates, 6 If it stops raining, 7 If I work late tonight, 8 If you do the shopping,

O'NG USTUN:
• (yuqorida 25-mashqning 7 va 8-bandlari)
• OCh KO'K quti, oq katta harflar 'When · If':
   • 'We use WHEN to show that something will certainly happen.' Qizil qiya: 'WHEN I go into town, I'll buy you a newspaper.'
   • 'We use IF when we are not certain that something will happen.' Qizil qiya: 'IF I go into town, I'll buy you a newspaper.'
26) 'Fill in IF or WHEN where necessary, and put the verbs in brackets into the correct form.' Uzun A/B dialogi, 15 ta nuqtali joy, qavsda fe'llar.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication: a) Making Appointments'.
27) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the dialogue and fill in WILL, 'M AFRAID, 'D LIKE, COULD or WOULD, then listen and check. Finally, use the prompts below to make similar dialogues.'
   Qiya ko'rsatmalar: 'Monday morning 9:30 - 11:45', 'Friday afternoon 4:30 - 5:00', 'Wednesday evening 6:00 - 6:30'.
   A/B dialogi, beshta nuqtali joy.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '38'.

exercises.instructionUz: Misollarni o'rganing, so'ng qoidani to'ldiring. Ishlatilishi
exercises.explanationUz:
1-TUR ShART GAPLARI
(CONDITIONALS TYPE 1).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IF + PRESENT SIMPLE,
  WILL + INFINITIVE (to SIZ)

     IF you DON'T HURRY UP,
     you WILL MISS the bus.

     IF I HAVE enough money,
     I'LL MOVE to a bigger house.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENG KATTA XATO                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ⚠ 'IF' dan keyin 'WILL' IShLATMANG!

     ✗ If you will hurry up, ...
     ✓ If you HURRY UP, ...

  ⚠ 'if' bo'lagida PRESENT SIMPLE,
  asosiy gapda 'will'.

  ⚠ Bu o'zbek tilidan farq qiladi:
  o'zbekchada IKKALA bo'lakda ham
  kelasi zamon bo'lishi mumkin.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QAChON IShLATILADI              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  HAQIQIY yoki JUDA EhTIMOLLI
  vaziyatlar - hozir yoki kelajakda.

  ⚠ 'If it rains, I'll stay at home.'
  (yomg'ir yog'ishi ehtimoli bor)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  VERGUL QOIDASI                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'if' bo'lagi OLDIN kelsa - VERGUL:
     'If it rains, I'll stay home.'

  'if' bo'lagi KEYIN kelsa - VERGUL
  YO'Q:
     'I'll stay home if it rains.'


⚠ 'INFINITIVE WITHOUT TO':

  = 'to' siz infinitiv, ya'ni fe'lning
  ASOSIY shakli.
  ⚠ 'will TO miss' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'will MISS' ✓


⚠ 'TO HURRY UP':

  = shoshilmoq.
  ⚠ 'Hurry up!' = Tezroq!


⚠ 'PROBABLE':

  = ehtimolli.
  ⚠ 'probably' = ehtimol (ravish).

points.en: If you don't hurry up, you will miss the bus.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'if' bo'lagida PRESENT SIMPLE ('don't hurry').
⚠ Asosiy gapda 'will' + fe'l.

points.en: If I have enough money, I'll move to a bigger house.
points.uz: Agar yetarli pulim bo'lsa, kattaroq uyga ko'chaman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'If I HAVE' - 'will have' EMAS!
⚠ "I'LL move" = 'I will move'.

points.en: Form: IF + present simple, WILL + infinitive without to
points.uz: Shakli: IF + hozirgi oddiy zamon, WILL + 'to' siz infinitiv
points.noteUz:
⚠ Qoidadagi ikki bo'sh joyga 'IF' va 'WILL'
yoziladi.
⚠ 'infinitive without to' = fe'lning asosiy
shakli.

points.en: We use conditionals type 1 to talk about real or very probable situations in the present or future.
points.uz: 1-tur shart gaplarini hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi haqiqiy yoki juda ehtimolli vaziyatlar haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.

points.en: NOT: If you will hurry up, ...
points.uz: XATO: If you will hurry up, ...
points.noteUz:
⚠ ENG KATTA XATO: 'if' dan keyin 'will'
IShLATMANG!
⚠ ✓ 'If you HURRY UP, ...'

exercises.explanationUz:
QUTIDAGI IKKI BO'Sh JOY.

  'Form: IF + present simple,
   WILL + infinitive without to'


⚠ ESLAB QOLISh:

  IF ... present simple
  ... WILL ... asosiy shakl

  ⚠ 'will' ikki bo'lakda ham
  bo'lmaydi!

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'IF' + PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'if' dan keyin HECh QAChON 'will' emas.

items.textEn: Form: if + present simple, ___ + infinitive without to
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'WILL' + 'to' SIZ infinitiv.
⚠ 'will TO miss' - XATO.

exercises.explanationUz:
BESh JUFTLIK.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 haven't got any money → d borrow
    some
  2 car breaks down → c phone for help
  3 a sunny day tomorrow → a go on a
    picnic
  4 get hungry → e make a sandwich
  5 go to London → b visit Buckingham
    Palace


⚠ 'BUCKINGHAM PALACE':

  Londondagi qirollik saroyi.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈbʌkɪŋəm/ - 'h'
  O'QILMAYDI.


⚠ 'TO BREAK DOWN':

  = buzilmoq (mashina, texnika).
  ⚠ Noto'g'ri fe'l: break - BROKE -
  BROKEN.
  ⚠ 'a breakdown' = buzilish (ot).


⚠ 'TO BORROW' va 'TO LEND':

  to borrow = qarz OLMOQ
  to lend = qarz BERMOQ

  ⚠ 'Can I borrow your pen?' ✓
  ⚠ 'Can you lend me your pen?' ✓
  ⚠ Ikkalasi ADAShTIRISh oson!


⚠ 'TO GO ON A PICNIC':

  ⚠ 'ON' predlogi bilan.
  ⚠ 'to go to a picnic' - XATO.


⚠ 'TO PHONE FOR HELP':

  = yordam so'rab qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'to phone' - Britaniyada,
  'to call' - hamma joyda.

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda STRELKA bilan ko'rsatilgan namuna.
⚠ 'to BORROW' = qarz OLMOQ ('lend' - bermoq).

⚠ 'to break down' = buzilmoq (texnika).
⚠ 'phone FOR help' - 'for' predlogi.

⚠ 'to go ON a picnic' - 'on' predlogi.
⚠ 'go to a picnic' - XATO.

⚠ 'to GET hungry' - holat o'zgarishi.
⚠ 'to MAKE a sandwich' - 'do' EMAS.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, act out dialogues in pairs, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: What WILL you DO if you
      HAVEN'T GOT any money?
  SB: If I HAVEN'T GOT any money,
      I'LL BORROW some.


⚠ SAVOL QOLIPI:

  What will you do if + PRESENT
  SIMPLE?

  ⚠ Savolda ham 'if' dan keyin
  PRESENT SIMPLE!


⚠ JAVOB QOLIPI:

  If + PRESENT SIMPLE, I'll + FE'L.


⚠ "HAVEN'T GOT":

  = 'don't have' (Britaniya
  so'zlashuvi).
  ⚠ 'I haven't got any money' =
  'I don't have any money'.


⚠ 'ANY' va 'SOME':

  INKORDA 'any': 'haven't got ANY
     money'
  TASDIQDA 'some': "I'll borrow
     SOME"

  ⚠ 'some' bu yerda 'some money'
  o'rnida - ot TAKRORLANMAYDI.

items.question: SA: What will you do if you haven't got any money?
items.answer: SB: If I haven't got any money, I'll borrow some.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobdagi namuna.
⚠ 'if' dan keyin PRESENT SIMPLE, asosiy gapda
"I'll".

items.prompt: mashina buzildi → yordam so'rab qo'ng'iroq qilmoq
items.question: SA: What will you do if your car breaks down?
items.answer: SB: If my car breaks down, I'll phone for help.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'breaks' - 3-shaxs birlik '-s'.
⚠ 'your car' → javobda 'my car'.

items.question: SA: What will you do if it's a sunny day tomorrow?
items.answer: SB: If it's a sunny day tomorrow, I'll go on a picnic.
items.whyUz:
⚠ "it's" = 'it is' - PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'go ON a picnic'.

items.question: SA: What will you do if you get hungry?
items.answer: SB: If I get hungry, I'll make a sandwich.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to get hungry' = qorni ochmoq.
⚠ 'to MAKE a sandwich'.

items.question: SA: What will you do if you go to London?
items.answer: SB: If I go to London, I'll visit Buckingham Palace.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to visit' - PREDLOGSIZ.
⚠ 'go TO London' - 'to' bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Follow the arrows and make sentences.
exercises.explanationUz:
ZANJIRLI ShART GAPLARI.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: If Jack DOESN'T HEAR his alarm
      clock, he WON'T WAKE UP.
  S2: If he DOESN'T WAKE UP, ...


⚠ ZANJIR QOIDASI:

  Har gapning ikkinchi qismi keyingi
  gapning BIRINChI qismiga aylanadi.

     ... he won't wake up.
     If he doesn't wake up, ...

  ⚠ "won't wake up" → "doesn't wake
  up" - ShAKL O'ZGARADI!


TO'LIQ ZANJIR:

  Jack/not hear his alarm clock
     → he/not wake up
     → he/be late for his interview
     → he/not get the job
     → he/not earn any money
     → he/spend his savings
     → he/be in big trouble!


⚠ 'AN ALARM CLOCK':

  = budilnik.
  ⚠ 'to set an alarm' = budilnikni
  qo'ymoq.


⚠ 'AN INTERVIEW':

  = suhbat (ishga qabul).
  ⚠ 'a job interview'.


⚠ 'SAVINGS':

  = jamg'arma.
  ⚠ HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
  ⚠ 'a saving' - bu ma'noda ishlatilmaydi.


⚠ 'TO BE IN BIG TROUBLE':

  = katta muammoga tushmoq.
  ⚠ 'trouble' - SANALMAYDIGAN,
  shuning uchun 'a big trouble' XATO.


⚠ 'TO EARN':

  = ishlab topmoq (pul).
  ⚠ 'to win' = yutmoq (o'yin, lotereya).
  ⚠ ADAShTIRMANG!
exercises.exampleEn: If Jack doesn't hear his alarm clock, he won't wake up.
modelAnswers: If Jack doesn't hear his alarm clock, he won't wake up.
If he doesn't wake up, he'll be late for his interview.
If he is late for his interview, he won't get the job.
If he doesn't get the job, he won't earn any money.
If he doesn't earn any money, he'll spend his savings.
If he spends his savings, he'll be in big trouble!
modelAnswersUz: Agar ishga olinmasa, pul ishlab topmaydi.
Agar pul ishlab topmasa, jamg'armasini sarflaydi.
Agar jamg'armasini sarflasa, katta muammoga tushadi!

exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ GAP BOShI - O'ZINGIZ
TUGALLAYSIZ.


⚠ HAR JAVOBDA 'WILL' BO'LIShI ShART:

  If + present simple, ... WILL ...


NAMUNA JAVOBLAR:

  1 If Jackie studies hard,
    she'll pass her exams.
  2 If you don't hurry,
    you'll miss the train.
  3 If I win £10,000,
    I'll buy a new car.
  4 If they go to Paris,
    they'll see the Eiffel Tower.
  5 If Bill eats all the chocolates,
    he'll feel sick.
  6 If it stops raining,
    we'll go to the park.
  7 If I work late tonight,
    I'll be tired tomorrow.
  8 If you do the shopping,
    I'll cook dinner.


⚠ 7 va 8-BANDLAR:

  Kitobda ular O'NG USTUNNING
  YUQORISIDA davom etadi.


⚠ '£10,000':

  = 'ten thousand pounds'.
  ⚠ Ingliz tilida MINGLIK VERGUL
  bilan ajratiladi: 10,000.
  ⚠ O'zbekchada bo'sh joy bilan:
  10 000.


⚠ 'TO WIN' va 'TO EARN':

  win = yutmoq (lotereya, o'yin)
  earn = ishlab topmoq

  ⚠ 3-bandda 'WIN £10,000' -
  lotereyada yutish.


⚠ 'TO STOP' + -ING:

  'If it stops RAINING' - 'stop'
  dan keyin -ING.
  ⚠ 'stop to rain' BOShQA ma'no:
  'yomg'ir yog'ish uchun to'xtamoq'.


⚠ 'TO FEEL SICK':

  = ko'ngli aynimoq.
  ⚠ 'sick' - 35-betdagi 8-mashqda.


⚠ 'TO DO THE SHOPPING':

  ⚠ 'do' bilan - 35-betdagi 9-mashq.

exercises.explanationUz:
'WHEN' va 'IF' FARQI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHEN = ANIQ bo'ladi             ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'WHEN I go into town, I'll buy you
   a newspaper.'

  ⚠ Men shaharga ALBATTA boraman -
  faqat qachonligi noma'lum.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IF = ANIQ EMAS                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'IF I go into town, I'll buy you
   a newspaper.'

  ⚠ Men shaharga borishim ham,
  bormasligim ham mumkin.


⚠ IKKALASIDAN KEYIN HAM PRESENT
   SIMPLE:

  ✗ When I WILL go into town, ...
  ✓ When I GO into town, ...

  ⚠ 'when' KELAJAK haqida bo'lsa ham
  PRESENT SIMPLE!

  ⚠ Lekin 'when' SAVOL bo'lsa,
  'will' bo'ladi:
     'WHEN WILL you go into town?'


⚠ ESLAB QOLISh:

  ALBATTA bo'ladi → when
  BALKI bo'lar → if

points.en: We use when to show that something will certainly happen.
points.uz: Biror narsa albatta ro'y berishini ko'rsatish uchun 'when' ishlatamiz.

points.en: When I go into town, I'll buy you a newspaper.
points.uz: Shaharga borganimda senga gazeta olib beraman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Shaharga ALBATTA boraman.
⚠ 'When I GO' - PRESENT SIMPLE!

points.en: We use if when we are not certain that something will happen.
points.uz: Biror narsa ro'y berishiga ishonchimiz komil bo'lmaganda 'if' ishlatamiz.

points.en: If I go into town, I'll buy you a newspaper.
points.uz: Agar shaharga borsam, senga gazeta olib beraman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Shaharga borishim ANIQ EMAS.
⚠ Ikki gap SO'ZMA-SO'Z bir xil, faqat
'when'/'if' farqi.

points.en: NOT: When I will go into town, ...
points.uz: XATO: When I will go into town, ...
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'when' dan keyin ham 'will' IShLATILMAYDI.
⚠ Faqat SAVOLDA: 'When WILL you go?'

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in if or when where necessary, and put the verbs in brackets into the correct form.
exercises.instructionUz: Kerak joyda if yoki when qo'ying va qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri shaklga soling.
exercises.explanationUz:
UZUN DIALOG - 15 BO'Sh JOY.


⚠ HAR SAFAR SO'RANG:

  ANIQ bo'ladimi? → when
  ANIQ emasmi? → if


TO'LIQ MATN:

  A: Now, about Saturday. I'm going
     to catch the 7:15 train, so I
     expect I'll reach the station at
     around 8:45. I 1) 'LL CALL you
     2) WHEN I 3) GET there.
  B: Okay, but 4) IF I 5) 'M NOT at
     home, I 6) 'LL BE on my way.
  A: Great. Now, where exactly shall
     I meet you?
  B: Ah, yes. 7) WHEN you 8) GET OFF
     the train, you 9) 'LL SEE a
     flight of stairs. Go down the
     stairs, and 10) WHEN you
     11) REACH the bottom, you
     12) 'LL BE on Farmer Street.
     There's a café there called Café
     Rouge. You can wait outside. But
     13) IF it 14) 'S wet, I 15) 'LL
     MEET you inside.
  A: Right. See you on Saturday.
  B: Yes. See you then.


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'WHEN'?

  2) 'when I get there' - u ALBATTA
     yetib boradi
  7) 'when you get off the train' -
     u ALBATTA tushadi
  10) 'when you reach the bottom' -
     u ALBATTA yetib boradi


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'IF'?

  4) "if I'm not at home" - uyda
     bo'lmasligi ANIQ EMAS
  13) "if it's wet" - yomg'ir
     yog'ishi ANIQ EMAS


⚠ 'A FLIGHT OF STAIRS':

  = zinapoya marshi (bir qavatlik
  zinalar to'plami).
  ⚠ 'flight' bu yerda 'parvoz' EMAS!


⚠ 'TO GET OFF' va 'TO GET ON':

  get off = tushmoq (poyezd,
     avtobus, samolyot)
  get on = chiqmoq

  ⚠ Mashina uchun 'get IN' / 'get OUT
  OF'.


⚠ 'ON MY WAY':

  = yo'ldaman.
  ⚠ "I'm on my way!" - juda ko'p
  ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'SHALL':

  'Where shall I meet you?'
  ⚠ 'shall' - taklif yoki maslahat
  so'raganda ('I' va 'we' bilan).
  ⚠ 'Where will I meet you?' ham
  mumkin, lekin 'shall' rasmiyroq.


⚠ VAQT O'QILIShI:

  7:15 → 'seven fifteen' yoki
     'quarter past seven'
  8:45 → 'eight forty-five' yoki
     'quarter to nine'

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Now, about Saturday. I'm going to catch the 7:15 train, so I expect I'll reach the station at around 8:45. I 1) ___ (call) you 2) ___ I 3) ___ (get) there.
lines.uz: Endi shanba haqida. 7:15 poyezdiga chiqaman, shuning uchun taxminan 8:45 da bekatga yetib borsam kerak. Yetib borganimda senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Okay, but 4) ___ I 5) ___ (not/be) at home, I 6) ___ (be) on my way.
lines.uz: Xo'p, lekin uyda bo'lmasam, yo'lda bo'laman.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great. Now, where exactly shall I meet you?
lines.uz: Zo'r. Endi, seni aynan qayerda uchrataman?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Ah, yes. 7) ___ you 8) ___ (get off) the train, you 9) ___ (see) a flight of stairs. Go down the stairs, and 10) ___ you 11) ___ (reach) the bottom, you 12) ___ (be) on Farmer Street.
lines.uz: Ha, aytmoqchi. Poyezddan tushganingda zinapoyani ko'rasan. Zinadan tushgin, va pastga yetganingda Farmer ko'chasida bo'lasan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: There's a café there called Café Rouge. You can wait outside. But 13) ___ it 14) ___ (be) wet, I 15) ___ (meet) you inside.
lines.uz: U yerda Café Rouge degan kafe bor. Tashqarida kutsang bo'ladi. Lekin yomg'ir yog'sa, seni ichkarida kutib olaman.

items.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda TAYYoR berilgan.
⚠ Asosiy gap → 'will'.
⚠ ALBATTA yetib boradi → 'when'.

⚠ 'when' dan keyin PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'when I will get' - XATO!

items.textEn: Okay, but 4) ___ I'm not at home ...
items.whyUz: ⚠ ANIQ EMAS → 'if'.

⚠ 'if' dan keyin PRESENT SIMPLE inkori.
⚠ "I'm not" = 'I am not'.

⚠ Asosiy gap → 'will be'.
⚠ 'on my way' = yo'ldaman.

items.textEn: Ah, yes. 7) ___ you get off the train ...
items.whyUz: ⚠ ALBATTA tushadi → 'when'.

⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'get OFF' = poyezddan tushmoq.

⚠ Asosiy gap → 'will see'.
⚠ 'a flight of stairs' = zinapoya marshi.

items.textEn: Go down the stairs, and 10) ___ you reach the bottom ...
items.whyUz: ⚠ ALBATTA yetadi → 'when'.

⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'to reach' - PREDLOGSIZ ('reach TO' XATO).

⚠ Asosiy gap → 'will be'.
⚠ 'ON Farmer Street' - Britaniyada 'in' ham
bo'ladi.
⚠ ANIQ EMAS → 'if'.

⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE: "it's" = 'it is'.
⚠ 'wet' bu yerda = yomg'irli, nam.

⚠ Asosiy gap → 'will meet'.
⚠ 'to meet' - PREDLOGSIZ.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and fill in will, 'm afraid, 'd like, could or would, then listen and check.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va will, 'm afraid, 'd like, could yoki would ni qo'ying, so'ng tinglab tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ShIFOKORGA NAVBAT OLISh.


TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: Good morning. I 1) 'D LIKE to
     see Dr Franks, please.
  B: I 2) 'M AFRAID you 3) 'LL have
     to make an appointment. He's
     very busy at the moment. Let me
     see - 4) WOULD tomorrow morning
     at 11:15 be all right for you?
  A: 5) COULD you make it a bit
     later?
  B: Certainly. Is 1:30 better?
  A: Yes, that's fine. Thank you very
     much.
  B: You're welcome.


⚠ "I'D LIKE TO ...":

  = ... qilmoqchiman (muloyim).
  ⚠ "I want to" dan ANChA muloyim.
  ⚠ "I'd" = 'I would'.


⚠ "I'M AFRAID ...":

  = afsuski, kechirasiz.
  ⚠ 'qo'rqaman' ma'nosida EMAS!
  ⚠ Yomon xabarni yumshatish uchun.


⚠ "YOU'LL HAVE TO ...":

  = ... qilishingizga to'g'ri keladi.
  ⚠ 'have to' ning kelasi zamoni.
  ⚠ 'you must' dan muloyimroq.


⚠ 'WOULD ... BE ALL RIGHT FOR YOU?':

  = ... sizga to'g'ri keladimi?
  ⚠ Taklif qilishning muloyim shakli.


⚠ 'COULD YOU ...?':

  = ... qila olasizmi?
  ⚠ 'Can you' dan muloyimroq.


⚠ 'TO MAKE AN APPOINTMENT':

  = navbat olmoq, uchrashuvga
  yozilmoq.
  ⚠ 'to make' bilan - 'to do' EMAS.


⚠ 'TO MAKE IT':

  'Could you make it a bit later?'
  = Biroz kechroq qila olasizmi?
  ⚠ 'to make it' = vaqtni kelishmoq.


⚠ 'A BIT':

  = biroz.
  ⚠ 'a little' bilan bir xil, lekin
  so'zlashuvda ko'proq.


⚠ "YOU'RE WELCOME":

  = arzimaydi.
  ⚠ 'Thank you' ga javob.


⚠ 'DR' QISQARTMASI:

  ⚠ Britaniyada NUQTASIZ: 'Dr Franks'.
  ⚠ AQShda nuqta bilan: 'Dr. Franks'.

exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh KO'RSATMA.

  Monday morning    9:30 - 11:45
  Friday afternoon  4:30 - 5:00
  Wednesday evening 6:00 - 6:30

  ⚠ BIRINChI vaqt - xizmatchi
  taklif qilgan vaqt.
  ⚠ IKKINChI vaqt - kelishilgan
  vaqt.


⚠ QOLIP:

  A: Good morning. I'd like to see
     Dr [ism], please.
  B: I'm afraid you'll have to make
     an appointment. He's very busy
     at the moment. Let me see -
     would [kun] at [vaqt] be all
     right for you?
  A: Could you make it a bit
     later/earlier?
  B: Certainly. Is [vaqt] better?
  A: Yes, that's fine. Thank you very
     much.
  B: You're welcome.


⚠ VAQT O'QILIShI:

  9:30 → 'half past nine'
  11:45 → 'quarter to twelve'
  4:30 → 'half past four'
  5:00 → 'five o'clock'
  6:00 → 'six o'clock'
  6:30 → 'half past six'


⚠ 'ON Monday morning' emas -
  'ON MONDAY MORNING' ✓
  ('in the morning' lekin
   'on Monday morning').

items.question: B: Would Monday morning at 9:30 be all right for you?

⚠ 11:45 → 'quarter to twelve'.

⚠ 5:00 → "five o'clock".

items.question: B: Would Wednesday evening at 6:00 be all right for you?

⚠ 6:00 → "six o'clock".
⚠ 6:30 → 'half past six'.

sentencePatterns.introUz: 1-tur shart gaplari va navbat olish qoliplari.

patterns.exampleEn: If you don't hurry up, you will miss the bus.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'if' dan keyin 'will' IShLATMANG!
⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' yo'q.

patterns.formula: What will you do if + PRESENT SIMPLE?
patterns.exampleEn: What will you do if you haven't got any money?
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Savolda ham 'if' dan keyin PRESENT SIMPLE.

patterns.exampleEn: When I go into town, I'll buy you a newspaper.
patterns.exampleUz: Shaharga borganimda senga gazeta olib beraman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'when' = ALBATTA bo'ladi.
⚠ 'when' dan keyin ham PRESENT SIMPLE.

patterns.exampleEn: I'd like to see Dr Franks, please.
I'm afraid you'll have to make an appointment.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "I'm afraid" = afsuski, 'qo'rqaman' EMAS.
⚠ "you'll have to" - 'you must' dan muloyimroq.

patterns.formula: Would [kun] at [vaqt] be all right for you?
patterns.exampleEn: Would tomorrow morning at 11:15 be all right for you?

patterns.formula: Could you make it a bit later?
patterns.exampleEn: Could you make it a bit later?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Could you' - 'Can you' dan muloyimroq.
⚠ 'to make it' = vaqtni kelishmoq.
